text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I arrive at the cafeteria for lunch, I see Air Groove speaking with some students.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I think my hamburger steak came out pretty good today. What do you think, Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You've improved since last time. However, the sauce could do with a little less salt.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you're going to flavor the meat itself with seasonings, a milder sauce would complement it better.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: That totally makes sense! Thanks so much! The next one will blow your socks off, promise!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I don't doubt it—you've made impressive progress already. Keep up the good work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The student walks off with a beaming smile.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I was sampling her cooking. It seems my honest critique is of some use to her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure when it started, but students sometimes bring me their home-made lunches to try.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A number of lunchboxes lie in front of Air Groove.
choice_data_list: You're going to try all of those?
You're going to try all of those?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I see what you're getting at.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But I can't turn down their requests. And besides, this isn't an impossible amount to eat.
choice_data_list: It looks like way too much to me.
I guess you don't have to worry about going hungry.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes, but I can't just return them without doing what I promised…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This really is none of your concern.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I've made my bed. If I must apologize, I'll do it myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But… you have my thanks, nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove goes around the cafeteria returning each lunchbox to its owner, apologizing as she does so.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I don't do this for the free meals. I enjoy helping them.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Whether it's training or cooking, I always respect the desire to improve at something.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It's only natural, considering I'm older than them. Nothing worth boasting about.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now, which do I eat first?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though Air Groove turns away dismissively, there's a note of kindness in her expression as she begins sampling the lunches.
